   1| def summarize(readings, limit):
   2|     """Return (count, mean, peak) for readings strictly below limit."""
   3|     kept = []
   4|     for value in readings:
   5|         if value <= limit:
   6|             kept.append(value)
   7|     if not kept:
   8|         return 0, 0.0, None
   9|     total = 0
  10|     for value in kept:
  11|         total += value
  12|     mean = total / len(kept)
  13|     peak = kept[0]
  14|     for value in kept[1:]:
  15|         if value > peak:
  16|             peak = value
  17|     return len(kept), mean, peak
  18| 
  19| 
  20| def describe(stats):
  21|     count, mean, peak = stats
  22|     return f"{count} readings, mean {mean:.2f}, peak {peak}"
